QuestInfo.name: Pet's Re-Evolution
QuestInfo.0: If I ever get tired of the evolving pet's current look, then I can re-evolve the evolving pet again for a different look.
QuestInfo.1: The re-evolution requires 1 #b#t5380000##k and 10,000 mesos again, just like the first time.
QuestInfo.2: The re-evolution had succeeded and now the evolving pet sports a different look.

0.0: If you are bored with your pet's current appearance, then try evolving it once more.

yes.0: For re-evolution you will need 1 #t5380000# just like the first time. I know you saw it in the Cash Shop before, so you know how to get it right?
yes.1: The cost is the same as well, 10,000 mesos. Can't you just see how much better your evolving pet will look?

no.0: Your heart's not ready yet? That's disappointing...

item.0: I thought I told you that you can't do it without the Rock of Evolution. Weren't you listening? Hurry up and find it!
